items.title: Updated default retry behavior for AWS SDKs and tools
items.summary: In May 2026, we announced an opt-in for updated retry behavior for the AWS SDKs, AWS Command Line Interface (AWS CLI), and AWS Tools for PowerShell. Starting November 10, 2026, the updated behavior is the default, and we have removed the opt-in. Availability varies by SDK and tool. See the SDK availability and GitHub issues […]
